shots.description: A receptionist at a hospital front desk holds up a sheet of paper and smiles as the camera moves past the desk, then the shot continues into a corridor where a nurse in a maroon uniform turns and smiles at the camera.

Camera moves through a doorway into a mammography room as a staff member in maroon scrubs walks towards the mammography unit. The room has a tree-image light panel on the wall, a supply trolley and a stool.
Camera moves from a 3Dimensions mammography machine through a department doorway, where a staff member in burgundy scrubs looks back and smiles before walking away down a hospital corridor.

A staff member in maroon scrubs walks down a hospital corridor and through a door into an MRI suite, then turns to speak to camera while gesturing towards the MRI scanner beside a 'Magnetic Field On' warning sign.

Empty patient waiting area with teal and cream armchairs, a teal sofa, round side tables with tissue boxes, a leaflet stand and framed artwork; the camera moves right and tilts up to an HCA wall sign and a notice reading 'You are entering a Clinical area, You must be Bare Below the Elbows'.

shots.description: Camera moves past wall signage reading 'You are entering a Clinical area, You must be Bare Below the Elbows', HCA notices and a hand sanitising sign, then reveals a waiting area where a woman sits on a green sofa reading a magazine.

shots.description: A woman sits on a teal sofa in a hospital waiting area, reading a magazine beside a coffee table and orchids, with a framed city skyline print on the wall behind her. The camera moves in slowly from a wide view to a closer shot of her reading.

Camera moves from outside a hospital entrance through the glass doors into reception, where a staff member in a suit stands holding a tablet in front of the front desk. Shows a welcoming arrival at a reception area.

The camera moves along a hospital corridor past a staircase and follows a staff member in a navy uniform as she walks through a doorway into a room with a window and sink, then passes close to the lens.
A nurse in a navy uniform walks through an empty private patient room with a made bed, an overbed table, an armchair and a window with an orchid on the sill, then stops by the window.

A nurse in navy scrubs enters a private patient room and uses the wall-mounted hand sanitiser by the sink. The camera moves on into the empty room, showing a drip stand, overbed table, desk and chair beneath large windows, and a wall-mounted TV.

A nurse in a navy uniform stands in a private patient room as the camera moves past an empty hospital bed with an overbed table and tablet, a recliner chair and wall art, ending on a window with an orchid on the sill.
A nurse in navy scrubs opens the door to a private patient room, and the camera moves inside past the handwash sink to show an empty, made hospital bed, a desk and large windows.
Empty private patient room with a made hospital bed, overbed table with a tablet, a patient chair and a large window with an orchid on the sill. The camera moves past the bed towards the window.
A nurse in navy scrubs opens a door and walks into an empty private patient room, revealing a hospital bed, overbed table, sink, desk and chair beside a large window.

Gimbal move through an empty private patient room, past a made hospital bed with an overbed table holding a tablet and information cards, a recliner chair and a door, ending on a window with a city view.

A nurse in a navy uniform walks into a private patient room and goes over to a woman sitting in an armchair beside the bed, then leans in to show her something on a tablet or folder. The patient smiles and talks with the nurse.
A nurse in navy HCA uniform stands talking with a seated patient in a high-backed chair. The patient hands a folder back to the nurse and they share a friendly conversation.
A nurse in navy scrubs walks into a private patient room and hands a folder to a woman seated in a chair beside the bed. The woman opens it and reads while they chat and smile.

A nurse holding a tablet talks with a smiling patient seated in a chair in a private patient room, then the camera pans right past the door to the windows overlooking a road and bridge, with an orchid in the foreground.
A nurse in a navy uniform walks into a private patient room and goes through a folder of information with a woman sitting in an armchair beside the bed. They talk and smile together.
A nurse in navy scrubs hands a tablet to a seated woman in a private patient room, then points across the room as the camera pans to a window with a city view.

A smiling clinician in navy scrubs holds open a door and welcomes the viewer into a consulting room, then sits down in a desk chair and smiles at the camera. The room has a desk, computer, printer, sink and cards on a shelf.
A clinician in navy scrubs walks into a consulting room, sits down at the desk and smiles at the camera. A shelf of thank-you cards is on the wall behind him.
A clinician in navy scrubs shows a man and a woman into a consulting room. They sit down at the desk and smile as the appointment begins.
A clinician in navy scrubs welcomes a man and a woman into a consulting room and they take their seats across the desk from him. The room has a computer monitor, chairs and examination couches.

A man and a woman sit side by side across a desk from a clinician, seen from behind at a computer, listening during a consultation. The camera moves in from an over-the-shoulder view to a closer shot of the couple.

A man and a woman sit side by side at a desk in a consulting room, listening to someone off camera during what appears to be a consultation. The camera moves out from a close angle to a wider view showing a computer monitor and an examination couch.

A consultant in navy scrubs sits at his desk in a consulting room and talks with a couple seated across from him, seen from behind. The camera moves past the couple toward the consultant as he gestures while explaining.

A consultant in blue scrubs sits at his desk talking with a couple in a consulting room, with the camera moving in closer. The clip then cuts to a pharmacy counter where a staff member in a green uniform smiles and hands over a boxed medication.
Pan along a wall of framed fertility information panels titled 'Egg freezing' and 'Genetic testing', showing images of a cryogenic storage tank and a lab dish under a pipette.

Camera moves across a welcome wall at Lister Fertility Clinic, from the introductory text to an illuminated plaque recording that the clinic was opened in 1988 by Mr Hossam 'Sam' Abdalla, and pushes in on the plaque.

shots.description: Camera moves out from behind a wooden door frame and glides forward down an empty, lit hospital corridor lined with wooden doors toward a door at the far end.
Camera moves from a hospital corridor with wooden doors into an empty children's waiting area with grey armchairs, a small play table with colourful chairs and baskets of toys.

A framed underwater illustration showing an octopus, whale, shells, fish and coral hangs on a white corridor wall, with small children's chairs and a table visible in a room beyond. The camera moves past the artwork from one side to the other.
A large framed illustration of a woodland scene with tall trees, giant mushrooms, deer and other animals hangs on a white wall. The camera moves slowly sideways past the artwork.
A LEGO model of an MRI suite in a clear display case, with a minifigure patient lying on the scanner table and a minifigure clinician in the control room. The camera moves in toward the model.
A LEGO model of a building with white-tiled rooms. A LEGO minifigure in a pink top stands in a lower room, and the camera moves up to reveal two more minifigures on the floor above.

A receptionist in a suit works at a computer at the front desk of HCA Healthcare UK's Chiswick Outpatients. The backlit HCA logo and Chiswick Outpatients sign are on the wall behind him, and a blurred figure passes close to the camera mid-shot.

shots.description: Camera moves from inside a building lobby out through the glass entrance doors at night, ending on the exterior entrance steps and surrounding buildings. No people are in shot and no hospital name is visible.

A receptionist works at the front desk of HCA Healthcare UK's Chiswick Outpatients beneath the HCA logo, then the camera moves out through the glass entrance doors to the building's exterior at night.

Camera pushes in from a wide view of the main reception desk at The Portland Hospital towards a male receptionist in a suit working at his computer. The HCA Healthcare UK logo and hospital name are on the wall behind him.

shots.description: The camera moves from potted blue hydrangeas on a corridor counter to a nurse in a maroon uniform, who opens a door and smiles back at the camera. Behind her is a blue-lit room with an underwater-themed mural and beds, in a corridor decorated with children's artwork.
A children's ultrasound room with sea-life wall murals, an ultrasound machine and an examination couch, followed by a paediatric corridor with sensory play panels on the walls as a person walks past.

Low-angle following shot of a staff member in a light blue tunic walking away down a paediatric outpatient corridor, past children's bead-maze wall toys, beige waiting chairs and pink stools towards a children's play area.

A staff member walks through double doors into a children's ward corridor painted with an underwater mural, and a red ride-on toy Tesla car drives alongside and then ahead of them down the corridor. The shot is filmed at floor level.
A staff member stands in a doorway and gestures toward a children's room, then the camera moves inside to show a sea-themed panda wall mural, a drip stand, a bed and sky-print ceiling panels.
Camera pans across a children's wall mural showing cartoon panda pirates on a pirate ship and a desert island with palm trees, in what appears to be a paediatric area of the hospital.
A toddler plays with a wall-mounted shape-sorting activity panel, turning a green wooden piece in a children's play area. The camera moves around her from one side to behind to the other side.

A toddler with a hair clip plays with coloured rings and shapes on a wall-mounted activity board in a hospital corridor play area. The child turns and moves the wooden pieces while the camera moves around her.

A toddler plays with shapes and toys mounted on a wall, then stands with a staff member who crouches beside her as they look up at a colourful underwater mural in a children's imaging room with lead aprons hanging nearby.

A staff member in a burgundy tunic crouches beside a toddler in front of an underwater-themed wall mural, then points out sea creatures to her. Child-friendly paediatric room with lead aprons hanging on the wall.

A radiographer crouches down to talk with a smiling toddler beside an underwater-themed wall mural in a paediatric X-ray room, with lead aprons hanging on the wall. The camera moves past them to show the X-ray machine as the radiographer prepares the equipment.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic smiles and plays with a young girl in an X-ray room, helping her feel at ease before her scan. The staff member then moves across frame, holding what appears to be a soft toy.
A staff member in a maroon tunic sits beside a smiling toddler in an X-ray room; she looks down at the child, then both look up and smile at someone off camera.

A staff member in a maroon tunic sits beside a toddler on a couch in an X-ray room, smiling and talking with her while the child plays with a small box. Ceiling-mounted X-ray equipment is visible above them.

A staff member in a maroon tunic sits beside a toddler on an X-ray table and shows her a picture card to keep her calm and engaged before an X-ray. A soft toy rabbit sits on the table, and the X-ray tube arm and wall stand are behind them.

A toddler in a hospital gown sits in an X-ray room while a staff member in a maroon tunic shows her picture cards to keep her calm and engaged. The child smiles and looks at the cards during the interaction.
A nurse in a burgundy uniform sits beside a smiling toddler on an examination couch and shows the child a picture card or small book in a clinic room.

A radiographer in maroon scrubs smiles and pulls playful faces while positioning an overhead X-ray tube, appearing to entertain a young child whose head is partly visible in the foreground of an X-ray room.
A toddler rests her hand on a Siemens Healthineers X-ray detector while a radiographer positions her fingers under a red laser alignment line and places a lead side marker for a hand X-ray.
A radiographer's hand positions a child's hand flat on an X-ray detector plate, lined up with the red laser guide, before a hand X-ray. Only the hands and the sleeve of the child's pink top are seen.

A young child sitting on an examination couch reaches into a basket of stickers held out by a member of staff, then the staff member in maroon scrubs smiles and laughs with the child. A paediatric appointment showing a reward or distraction moment.
A smiling toddler girl in a pink pinafore sits in a paediatric consulting room while a staff member in a burgundy top holds her hand and attends to her finger during a check-up.

A toddler in a white top plays in a paediatric area, then the shot moves across an underwater-themed wall mural to a patient room where a nurse in teal scrubs sits on a hospital bed talking with a young child in a patterned gown.

A staff member in a teal polo shirt sits on a hospital bed with a young girl in patterned pyjamas, playing with a small toy together in a children's patient room. The girl is seen from behind, with wall-mounted medical equipment in the background.

shots.description: A staff member in a teal polo shirt uses a baby doll and a toy panda to show a young girl in a hospital gown how to use a breathing mask, and the child holds the mask up to her own face. The scene takes place in a children's hospital room with a bed and a sensory bubble light.
A young girl in patterned pyjamas sits on a hospital bed while a female staff member in a teal top plays with her using baby dolls and a panda soft toy in a children's patient room.

A staff member in a teal polo shirt uses a baby doll to show a young child how a breathing mask works, as the child holds the mask in the foreground. This appears to be play preparation in a children's room, with a panda soft toy nearby.

Camera tilts down from a ceiling lit by a coloured light projection to show a nurse in blue scrubs sitting with a young girl on a hospital bed in a paediatric room with a sensory bubble tube. The nurse smiles and talks with the child, who has her back partly to camera.

A staff member in a teal polo shirt sits on a hospital bed with a young girl in a printed hospital gown, using a baby doll and a toy panda to talk with her in a paediatric patient room. The girl is seen from behind as the staff member smiles and shows her the doll.

A nurse sits on a hospital bed with a young girl in a patterned gown, playing with a baby doll together in a children's room with a bubble tube sensory light. The camera then moves to show a children's sensory play room with soft play blocks and floor mats.

A staff member plays with a toddler in a sensory room, reaching up to hanging chimes, then supporting her as she sits on a red therapy ball and climbs onto a large blue ball beside fibre optic light strands.
A staff member in a green uniform kneels beside a young child in a sensory play room as the child looks at and touches a light-up LED mirror panel and smiles at their reflection.
A toddler stands at a wall of textured sensory panels and touches them while a woman in a dark top crouches beside her and guides her hands, in a sensory play room with coloured lighting.

A physiotherapist holds a remote control and talks with a young boy as he walks on a treadmill with handrails in front of a mirror during a paediatric rehabilitation session. The shot is framed over her shoulder.
A young boy walks on a treadmill with handrails in front of a mirror while a physiotherapist stands beside him holding a handheld controller during a paediatric rehabilitation session.

A young boy walks on a small treadmill with a handrail frame, watching himself in a freestanding mirror, while a staff member beside him uses a handheld device to control the session in a bright rehab room.
A physiotherapist holds a handheld controller while a young boy walks on a low treadmill with handrails during a paediatric rehabilitation session in a therapy room.

A young boy holds the handlebar of a metal walking frame in a bright room with a ceiling hoist track, filmed from a low angle as the camera moves around him during a paediatric rehabilitation session.

A physiotherapist sits beside a young boy on a treatment couch and places her hands on his lower back to assess his posture and spine, in a children's treatment room with an underwater-themed wall mural. Both are seen from behind.

A physiotherapist in a navy top and a patient lift a red exercise ball overhead together during a rehabilitation session in a therapy room. The shot opens on their hands on the ball and moves to show the physiotherapist from behind.

A staff member in a navy top guides a young boy through a physiotherapy exercise with a red exercise ball in front of a sea-life wall mural, stretching his arms out and then lifting the ball overhead. Filmed over the shoulder from behind during a children's rehab session.

A physiotherapist guides a young boy as he holds a red exercise ball above his head against a wall with an underwater mural. The shot opens on their hands on the ball and pulls back to show the paediatric physiotherapy session.
A radiographer in a maroon tunic guides a young boy in a hospital gown into position at an upright X-ray stand, then adjusts the equipment above him while he waits.
A nurse measures a young boy's height as he stands against the wall in a hospital gown in a patient room, placing a measuring bar on top of his head.
A radiographer positions a young boy in a hospital gown at an upright X-ray stand, where he holds an overhead bar while she adjusts the X-ray equipment and steps back.

A radiographer positions a young boy in a hospital gown against an upright X-ray detector as he holds the overhead handle with his arms raised. She uses the positioning controls and adjusts the panel to prepare him for a standing X-ray.

A young boy in a hospital gown stands in an upright X-ray imaging unit, reaches up to grip an overhead handle bar and holds his arms raised while green positioning laser lines cross his face and body. kit: upright imaging stand with overhead handle bar

shots.description: A radiographer positions a young boy in a hospital gown inside a standing X-ray imaging booth, guiding him to raise his arms and hold the overhead handle bar while green positioning laser lines show on the panels.

An empty private patient room with a made hospital bed, an overbed table holding a dark folder, a wall-mounted TV, a desk and a curtained window. The camera moves through the room and ends looking back in from the doorway.

Camera moves through an empty private patient room with a made-up hospital bed by a large curtained window, passes close to the pillows and overbed table, then pulls back to the doorway where a nurse in a red tunic smiles and holds the door open.
Empty private patient room, moving from a made hospital bed with a folder on the overbed table across to a seating area with armchairs, a sofa, a coffee table and a coffee machine by the window.

A welcome gift is set out on the dressing table of a private patient room: a white bag with a panda soft toy, a rolled item and a bottle, beside a blue storage box and bottled water with glasses on a tray. The room's bed shows in the round mirror as the camera moves along the desk.
kit: bottled water and glasses on tray

shots.description: Camera moves across a private patient room, past a desk holding a toiletry bag, a panda soft toy, a bottle and a glass, to a sideboard with a lit table lamp, a vase of flowers and a coffee machine beside an armchair.
A private patient room with a lamp, fresh flowers and a coffee machine on a side table. The camera moves low across a table with a fruit platter towards an armchair and cabinet.

A nurse in a red uniform smiles over her shoulder at the camera, then walks through a doorway into an empty private patient room with a made hospital bed, overbed table and bedside lamp. The camera follows her in.

Camera moves past a bedside lamp, fresh flowers and a coffee machine on a cabinet in a private patient suite, then reveals the adjoining room with a made hospital bed and overbed table. No people are in shot.

A staff member in a white shirt and dark waistcoat wheels a meal trolley with a covered cloche tray along a hospital corridor towards the camera, seen through an open doorway, and smiles as she approaches.
A catering staff member wheels a meal trolley into a patient room and lifts the silver cloche to reveal a plated hot meal on a tray. Inpatient dining and hospitality service.

A sonographer in a burgundy uniform operates an ultrasound machine in a dimly lit scanning room. She looks at the monitor, which shows a fetal ultrasound image by the end of the shot, while desktop computers sit in the background.
A sonographer in a burgundy uniform carries out a pregnancy ultrasound scan, using the control panel and smiling as she talks to an off-camera patient while a fetal image shows on the monitor.

A sonographer in a burgundy uniform operates an ultrasound console while talking to someone off camera. A scan image is projected on the wall behind her, with a desk and computer monitor in the background.
A sonographer in a maroon tunic points to a fetal ultrasound image projected on the wall of a scan room, laughs while talking to someone off camera, then works the controls of the ultrasound machine.

Camera moves from a period doorway with ornate ironwork glass past a reception desk to reveal a receptionist at a computer, who smiles while working. An HCA Healthcare UK logo is on the wall behind her.

View from a clinic entrance onto a London Georgian terraced street with parked cars and potted topiary, moving inside to pink and white orchids on a reception desk with a blurred HCA logo sign behind.

Interior of a period building showing a dark wooden staircase with turned balusters, white walls and a tall paned window, with a hallway leading to a wooden door. The camera turns slowly around the empty stairwell.

shots.description: An empty patient waiting lounge with upholstered armchairs, table lamps, potted plants and a wall-mounted TV, with daylight coming through blinded windows. The camera moves smoothly through the room.
A man in a suit sits in an armchair in a hospital waiting lounge reading a newspaper, and the camera moves in as he smiles while turning the pages.

A man in a suit sits in an armchair in a waiting lounge and reads a newspaper, with table lamps, plants and window blinds behind him. The camera arcs from a close side profile to a medium front-on view of him reading.

A pharmacy staff member in a green uniform and headscarf walks up to the pharmacy dispensing hatch and holds out a green and white prescription bag towards the camera, smiling. Medicine shelving and computer workstations are visible in the pharmacy behind her.

A nurse in green scrubs and a headscarf carries a folder away from a ward nurses' station, smiling and talking to camera as she walks. The camera follows her past a wall and into a bright hospital entrance area with security gates.
A nurse in uniform holds open a door from a hospital corridor and leads the camera into a treatment room with a patient trolley, waste bins, glove dispenser and sink, then walks past the camera.
A nurse in a blue uniform leads the camera from a hospital corridor into a treatment room with a stretcher trolley and wheeled equipment, then turns to speak while standing by the glove dispenser.
A receptionist with glasses and a name badge sits at a desk behind two computer monitors in a reception area. She looks up toward the camera, then turns back to work on her computer.

A staff member with long curly hair and glasses, wearing a light blue shirt and carrying a clipboard, walks away from camera down a hospital corridor. The camera follows behind her past noticeboards, wall panels and a hand sanitiser dispenser.

A staff member with curly hair and glasses carries a tablet along a hospital corridor, walks through double doors into a patient room with a hand-wash sink, then turns and smiles back toward the camera.
A nurse in blue scrubs holding a tablet talks with a male patient sitting up in a hospital bed in a private patient room, with a patient monitor on the wall behind them.

A nurse in blue scrubs holding a tablet talks with a male patient sitting up in a hospital bed in a patient room. A blood pressure cuff is on his arm, and the patient smiles and responds as she records his observations.
A nurse in blue scrubs fits a blood pressure cuff to the arm of a male patient sitting up in a hospital bed, then clips a pulse oximeter onto his finger to take his observations.

Camera moves across an empty, made-up private patient room with a hospital bed, an over-bed table holding a folder, armchairs, a wall-mounted monitor and a bedside cabinet by the window.

An empty private patient room with a made-up Hill-Rom hospital bed, a grey armchair by the window, a bedside cabinet and a wall-mounted patient monitor. The camera moves slowly in towards the foot of the bed.
A nurse walks into a private patient room and talks with a patient sitting up in bed in a hospital gown, holding a folder. They laugh and chat as the nurse stands by the bed.
A nurse hands a patient in a hospital gown a small medicine cup as she sits up in bed in a private patient room. The patient then takes a glass of water and talks with the nurse.
A patient in a hospital gown sits on her bed holding a cup and chatting, as a nurse in a blue uniform comes over and talks with her in a private patient room by the window.
A nurse walks from the corridor into a private patient room and hands a glass of water to a patient sitting up in bed, and the two chat at the bedside.

A nurse talks with a patient sitting up in a hospital bed in a patient room. The patient holds a small medicine cup, then takes her medication with a glass of water while the nurse checks the wall-mounted monitor.
A nurse in a light blue uniform unfolds a sheet or towel and prepares the bed while a patient in a hospital gown sits up and laughs with her in a private patient room.

A nurse adjusts an infusion pump on a drip stand, then leans over to attend to a patient sitting up in bed in a hospital gown and talking with her, in a patient room with a window and floral curtains.

A nurse in a blue uniform talks with a female patient sitting up in bed in a private hospital room, then looks down at paperwork on the overbed table. A glass of water and a folder sit on the table, and a vital signs monitor is mounted on the wall behind.

A nurse in a blue uniform stands at the bedside talking with a female patient sitting up in bed in a private patient room. An overbed table with a glass of water, a folder and paperwork sits between them.
A smiling nurse in a blue uniform chats with a patient sitting up in a hospital bed in a private patient room, while unpacking medical supplies with tubing at the bedside.

A nurse in a blue uniform stands by the window holding a cable from a wall-mounted unit while talking with a patient in a hospital gown seated in a chair in a patient room. Both smile during the conversation.
A nurse in a blue uniform hands a glass of water to a patient sitting in a hospital bed. The patient takes the glass and smiles as the nurse stands by the bedside.
A patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a patient room, smiling and looking ahead, while a nurse in a blue uniform adjusts an IV drip bag on a stand behind her.
A nurse in a blue uniform fits a blood pressure cuff on a smiling female patient in a hospital gown sitting up in bed, taking the cuff from its packaging and placing it on her arm.

A nurse in a blue uniform stands beside a hospital bed with her hands clasped, talking with a smiling female patient in a hospital gown who is sitting up in bed in a private patient room. Window light backlights the nurse.
